why_agent_cannot: log in or create the account (human session)
what_human_must_do: Log in / create the account in the shared profile, then the agent can continue.
steps_from_source: 1 Step 1 : Download the game Install ONE Fight Arena from Google Play or the Apple App Store .
2 Step 2 : Log in or sign up on the project site The ONE Fight Arena homepage offers Log in and Sign up buttons for accounts.
3 Step 3 : Open the Pro Arena quests On the homepage, select Enter under Exclusives in Pro Arena, or choose Quests in the menu.
4 Step 4 : Complete quests to earn Adrenaline Work through the simple quests on offer. Each completed quest earns Adrenaline, and the project says more challenges are coming.
5 Step 5 : Unlock rewards with Adrenaline Use your Adrenaline to unlock rewards such as ONE Championship merchandise, exclusive game content, SUI tokens or NFTs.
